methodology.runtime: Production bundles on the same PC and hardware GPU; six riders on official track 1, held normal throttle. Three 30-second samples per configuration, 5-second warmup, 1920x1080, Chromium. Baseline group followed by candidate group; no profiling during these samples.
methodology.frameMetric: requestAnimationFrame interval, limited by the 60 Hz refresh rate; not a direct measurement of GPU execution time.
methodology.cpuMetric: Wall time spent in requestAnimationFrame callbacks, including command submission. Medians of the three sample p95 values; no gl.finish().
methodology.resources: Same staged scene; candidate adds sand/gravel. Attribute and uploaded texture byte estimates exclude unchanged composer targets and driver overhead.
methodology.baseline: Original source/public/dist snapshot made before terrain changes. sourceVersion reads the shared Git directory and therefore says dirty on the final baseline run; buildFingerprint identifies the preserved production bundle.
caveats: A 60 Hz frame interval can hide CPU/GPU headroom differences.
Terrain physics changes rider speed/positions in the full race; a separate fixed-position diagnostic isolates presentation cost.
CPU p95 varied substantially across runs in both versions. Initial results remain included.
No physical phone or lower-powered notebook measured. Landscape mobile QA uses browser viewports.
Resource bytes estimate scene buffers and uploaded texture sizes, not total VRAM.

fixedPosition.method: 300 RAF frames after 90 warmup frames, same six staged rider positions, development modules, V8 sampling profiler active. Not the production acceptance benchmark.

productionProfile.method: 20-second high/morning/clear production race with V8 sampling profiler active. Diagnostic only; totals include idle time.

validation.migrations: IndexedDB 4 to 5 rollback on injected failure, retry, profile/vehicle/settings preservation, obsolete result removal, idempotent reopen and one-time menu notice verified in all three browsers.
